name: Andorra
intro: Andorra's one starred restaurant is in the ski resort of Soldeu. Prices are in euros, with a switch to see them in pounds or US dollars, and include Andorra's sales tax. Prices checked October 2026.
serviceText: Every figure is for one guest, before drinks. Andorran menu prices include its sales tax (IGI); service isn't usually added, and tipping is up to you. Prices shown in other currencies use the day's exchange rate and are approximate.
sourcesText: Dinner is the restaurant's longer tasting menu. Prices come from recent listings, as the hotel's own site doesn't publish them.
starsText: The Google reviews score out of 5 and the number of reviews, checked in October 2026. Stars come from the MICHELIN Guide Spain 2026, which covers Andorra.
